label: input h at late original positions (t >= 6)
explanation: Fires when the input token is the letter h at original-phase position 6, 7 or 8 (only reachable in L=7..9 sequences). Every such step is active (dev precision 1.0). Magnitude rises steeply with position: about 0.15-0.25 of max at t=6, about 0.55-0.6 at t=7, and near max at t=8 (top examples are all h as the 8th-index/last token of L=9 sequences). Does not fire on h at t<=5, on any other token (the few non-h hits are tiny, <0.05 of max, mostly at t=8), on the delimiter, or anywhere in the copy phase, including when h is being output or input there. Not modulated by neighbouring tokens, first token or digit count.

issues: Minor: the claim that it never fires on the delimiter is not literally true. One dev step at the delimiter (t=9, L=9) is active, with negligible mass. Copy phase has 0 active steps, which matches the claim.

The 116 test misses are scattered tiny activations (at most 0.03 of max), almost all at t=8 on random non-h tokens, holding 0.0% of mass. One sits right after an h at t=7. This is noise, not a systematic class.

The predicate gives 0 false positives on test. Magnitude depends on t, not on to_go: h at t=6 is about 0.14-0.26 of max whether or not it is the last token, about 0.57 at t=7 and close to 1.0 at t=8. Prev/first token, digit count and in_count are flat. All of this matches the explanation.
